"sec A + cosec A"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "1", "solution_html": {"en": "\n Shortcut Trick\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Put a specific value for angle A where the expression is defined.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Let A = 45° is not possible as denominators become zero. Let A = 30°.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Expression = [tan 30° / (1 − cot 30°)] + [cot 30° / (1 − tan 30°)] = [(1/√3) / (1 − √3)] + [√3 / (1 − 1/√3)]

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          = [1 / (√3 − 3)] + [3 / (√3 − 1)] = 1 + 2/√3 + 1 = 1 + sec 30° cosec 30°.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ∴ The correct answer is 1 + sec A cosec A.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Alternate Method

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Given: \\(\\frac{\\tan A}{1 \\space-\\space \\cot A} + \\frac{\\cot A}{1 \\space-\\space \\tan A}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Formula Used: tan A = sin A / cos A; cot A = cos A / sin A; a3 − b3 = (a − b)(a2 + ab + b2)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ [(sin A / cos A) / (1 − cos A / sin A)] + [(cos A / sin A) / (1 − sin A / cos A)]

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ [sin2 A / (cos A(sin A − cos A))] + [cos2 A / (sin A(cos A − sin A))]

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ [sin2 A / (cos A(sin A − cos A))] − [cos2 A / (sin A(sin A − cos A))]

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ (sin3 A − cos3 A) / [sin A cos A (sin A − cos A)]

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ [(sin A − cos A)(sin2 A + cos2 A + sin A cos A)] / [sin A cos A (sin A − cos A)]

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ (1 + sin A cos A) / (sin A cos A)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ (1 / sin A cos A) + (sin A cos A / sin A cos A) = sec A cosec A + 1

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ∴ The correct answer is 1 + sec A cosec A.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Fundamental Identities

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          sin2 A + cos2 A = 1 | 1 + tan2 A = sec2 A | 1 + cot2 A = cosec2 A.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Reciprocal Relations

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          cosec A = 1 / sin A | sec A = 1 / cos A | cot A = 1 / tan A. Shortcut Trick\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          कोण A के लिए एक विशिष्ट मान रखें जहाँ व्यंजक परिभाषित है।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          माना A = 45° संभव नहीं है क्योंकि हर शून्य हो जाते हैं। माना A = 30°।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          व्यंजक = [tan 30° / (1 − cot 30°)] + [cot 30° / (1 − tan 30°)] = [(1/√3) / (1 − √3)] + [√3 / (1 − 1/√3)]

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          = [1 / (√3 − 3)] + [3 / (√3 − 1)] = 1 + 2/√3 + 1 = 1 + sec 30° cosec 30°.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ∴ सही उत्तर 1 + sec A cosec A है।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Alternate Method

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          दिया गया है: \\(\\frac{\\tan A}{1 \\space-\\space \\cot A} + \\frac{\\cot A}{1 \\space-\\space \\tan A}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          प्रयुक्त सूत्र: tan A = sin A / cos A; cot A = cos A / sin A; a3 − b3 = (a − b)(a2 + ab + b2)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ [(sin A / cos A) / (1 − cos A / sin A)] + [(cos A / sin A) / (1 − sin A / cos A)]

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ [sin2 A / (cos A(sin A − cos A))] + [cos2 A / (sin A(cos A − sin A))]

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ [sin2 A / (cos A(sin A − cos A))] − [cos2 A / (sin A(sin A − cos A))]

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ (sin3 A − cos3 A) / [sin A cos A (sin A − cos A)]

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ [(sin A − cos A)(sin2 A + cos2 A + sin A cos A)] / [sin A cos A (sin A − cos A)]

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ (1 + sin A cos A) / (sin A cos A)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ (1 / sin A cos A) + (sin A cos A / sin A cos A) = sec A cosec A + 1

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ∴ सही उत्तर 1 + sec A cosec A है।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          मौलिक सर्वसमिकाएँ (Fundamental Identities)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          sin2 A + cos2 A = 1 | 1 + tan2 A = sec2 A | 1 + cot2 A = cosec2 A.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          व्युत्क्रम संबंध (Reciprocal Relations)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          cosec A = 1 / sin A | sec A = 1 / cos A | cot A = 1 / tan A.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n196:Tb74,\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ఇచ్చింది:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \\(\\frac{\\tan A}{1 \\space-\\space \\cot A} + \\frac{\\cot A}{1 \\space-\\space \\tan A}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ఉపయోగించిన భావన:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Sin<", "te": "\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ఇచ్చింది:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \\(\\frac{\\tan A}{1 \\space-\\space \\cot A} + \\frac{\\cot A}{1 \\space-\\space \\tan A}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ఉపయోగించిన భావన:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Sin2θ + Cos2θ = 1

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          a3 - b3 = (a - b)(a2 + b2 + ab)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          గణన​:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \\(\\frac{\\tan A}{1 \\space-\\space \\cot A} + \\frac{\\cot A}{1 \\space-\\space \\tan A}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ \\(\\frac{\\tan A}{1 \\space-\\space \\frac{1}{tan A}} + \\frac{\\frac{1}{tan A}}{1 \\space-\\space \\tan A}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ \\(\\frac{\\tan^2 A}{{tan A\\space-\\space1}} + \\frac{{1}{}}{tan A \\space-\\space \\tan^2 A}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Sin2θ + Cos2θ = 1

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          a3 - b3 = (a - b)(a2 + b2 + ab)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ଗଣନା:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \\(\\frac{\\tan A}{1 \\space-\\space \\cot A} + \\frac{\\cot A}{1 \\space-\\space \\tan A}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ \\(\\frac{\\tan A}{1 \\space-\\space \\frac{1}{tan A}} + \\frac{\\frac{1}{tan A}}{1 \\space-\\space \\tan A}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ \\(\\frac{\\tan^2 A}{{tan A\\space-\\space1}} + \\frac{{1}{}}{tan A \\space-\\space \\tan^2 A}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ \\(\\frac{\\tan^2 A}{{tan A\\space-\\space1}} - \\frac{{1}{}}{tan A(tan A \\space-\\space 1)}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ \\(\\frac{\\tan^3 A \\space-\\space1}{{tanA(tan A\\space-\\space1)}}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ \\(\\frac{(\\tan A \\space-\\space1)(\\tan ^2A + 1 +tanA)}{{\\tan A(\\tan A\\space-\\space1)}}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ \\(\\frac{(\\tan ^2A + 1 +tanA)}{{\\tan A}}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ tanA + cotA + 1

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ \\(\\frac{\\sin A}{{\\cos A}}+\\frac{\\cos A}{\\sin A} + 1\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ \\(\\frac{\\sin^2 A+\\cos^ 2A + cosAsinA}{{\\cos AsinA}}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ \\(\\frac{1 + cosAsinA}{{\\cos AsinA}}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ \\(\\frac{1}{{\\cos AsinA}} + 1\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ 1 + sec A cosec A

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ∴ ଆବଶ୍ୟକ ଉତ୍ତର ହେଉଛି 1 + ସେକେଣ୍ଡ୍ ଏକ କୋସେକ A |

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          The correct answer is  Kamini.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Key Points

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • KAMINI (Kalpakkam Mini reactor) is a research reactor at Kalpakkam's Indira Gandhi Center for Atomic Research.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • On October 29, 1996, it reached criticality.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\tThe Bhabha Atomic Research Centre (BARC) and the Indira Gandhi Centre for Atomic Research collaborated on its design and construction (IGCAR).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • At full capacity, it generates 30 KW of heat energy.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • KAMINI is cooled and moderated by light water and powered by uranium-233 metal produced by the nearby FBTR reactor's thorium fuel cycle.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • It is the world's sole thorium-based experimental reactor as of 2006.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • KAMINI was the first and remains the world's only reactor constructed particularly for Uranium-233 fuel.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • A primary aim of India's nuclear energy programme is to use its enormous thorium stockpiles to create nuclear fuel.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Dhruva:\n\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • India's largest nuclear research reactor is the Dhruva reactor. It was the first nuclear power plant in Asia.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Hanul:\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Hanul Nuclear Power Plant is a big nuclear power plant in South Korea's Gyeongsangbuk-do region.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • In 2013, the name of the plant was changed from Uljin to Hanul.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Apsara:\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Apsara was created in August 1956 and is a highly adaptable swimming pool-type reactor. In 2009, it was closed for renovations.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Apsara, Asia's oldest research reactor, has been recommissioned with double its former capacity at India's nuclear weapons plant at the Bhabha Atomic Research Center (BARC) in Mumbai.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ", "hn": "\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          सही उत्तर कामिनी है।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Key Points

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • कामिनी (कलपक्कम मिनी रिएक्टर) कलपक्कम के इंदिरा गांधी परमाणु अनुसंधान केंद्र में एक अनुसंधान रिएक्टर है।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • 29 अक्टूबर 1996 को यह गंभीर स्थिति में पहुंच गया।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\tभाभा परमाणु अनुसंधान केंद्र (BARC) और इंदिरा गांधी परमाणु अनुसंधान केंद्र (IGCAR) ने इसके डिजाइन और निर्माण पर सहयोग किया।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
